name: Focus on a chosen subject
short_description: Focus on a chosen subject once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can focus on a chosen subject in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Focus on a chosen subject means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Focus on a chosen subject in a fresh real-life scenario.

builds_on.note: Catch a ball while moving helps develop focus on a chosen subject but is not indispensable.
Catch a slowly tossed ball helps develop focus on a chosen subject but is not indispensable.
Kick a stationary ball helps develop focus on a chosen subject but is not indispensable.
